comment: An extraordinary experience from start to finish. The infinity pool overlooking the Malibu sunset was even more breathtaking in person than in the photos. Elena was the consummate host.
Unbelievable beachfront access and architectural detail. The kitchen was equipped like a Michelin restaurant. We fell asleep each night to the sound of crashing waves.
Watching the Northern Lights dance directly above through the bedroom skylight was a bucket-list memory. The outdoor cedar hot tub in sub-zero air was magical.
Cozy, warm, and deeply authentic Norwegian cabin charm. The wood-fired sauna after snowshoeing was perfection.
Staying in this restored Tuscan estate felt like stepping into an Italian romance film. We harvested fresh herbs from the terrace for homemade pasta.
The caldera pool in Santorini is legendary. Having breakfast served on our sun terrace watching the sailboats below was pure bliss.
Zen perfection in Kyoto. The integration of modern minimalist design with historic Machiya woodcraft is world-class. Loved the onsen soaking tub.
Lake Como at its finest. Having a private boat dock allowed us to tour Bellagio and Varenna effortlessly. Can't wait to return.
The water in Bora Bora is surreal. Snorkeling directly off our villa deck with rays and tropical fish every morning was incredible.
The Matterhorn views from the heated outdoor pool are unlike anything else on Earth. Pristine chalet luxury and top-notch ski access.
The ultimate luxury estate in Beverly Hills. The screening room and infinity pool views overlooking the LA skyline made our celebration unforgettable.
The A-frame in Big Sur is the coziest retreat imaginable. Peaceful sounds of the creek, giant redwoods, and wonderful vinyl records.
Architectural masterpiece in the desert. The mirrored walls blend into the rocks, and watching the stars with the telescope was unmatched.
The fragrance of lavender at dusk, warm Provence breezes, and authentic stone craftsmanship. A dream vacation.
